title: Chongqing slope: Horn vs Zevenbergen–Thorne
description: Two real GDAL slope runs on the same preserved 100 m DSM, with recorded comparison metrics and a verified Horn replay. Metadata only; Cumora does not execute raster commands.
provenance: Copernicus DEM GLO-90 AWS 2021 COG release; 3 arc-second native grid, nominal 90 m; DSM
Chongqing municipality, prior OSM relation 913069 mask; not limited to the traditional central nine districts
Bilinear resampling to local WGS84 Transverse Mercator, lon0 108 E, scale 1, false easting 500000 m; 100 m grid; stored Int16 whole metres; centre-point boundary clipping.
Exact replay starts at this preserved 100 m input; neither the raw 30 source tiles nor a byte-exact prior warp reconstruction are claimed.
The input is a previously resampled and Int16-quantised DSM, not a native 100 m terrain DTM.
Input, output, and source raster tile bytes are absent from this repository fixture.
The archived Horn replay was verified on Linux/GDAL 3.10.3 only. Windows execution was not verified.
The prior README is retained verbatim as provenance; its download timestamps were not independently re-verified in this slope task.
